verdict.rationale: Brex explicitly markets AI-powered invoice entry, approval, and payments automation with budget/spend controls (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-6), directly matching the bill-upload-and-approval-workflow story, but there is no detailed documentation of the approval workflow mechanics (multi-step routing, approver hierarchies) and community sentiment raises concerns about AI reliability in financial automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the approval routing workflow, detailed docs on configuring approval chains, and confirmation the AI automation performs reliably in production beyond marketing claims.
